verdict.rationale: Runpod documents an official, open-source CLI (runpodctl). It manages Pods, Serverless endpoints, templates, network volumes and models, transfers files, diagnoses issues and shows account info, with concrete commands such as `runpodctl pod create`. A separate Flash CLI (init/login) is also documented, and a probe confirmed the official CLI docs page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the CLI in use.
